entities.summary: Josef Roman Lorenz, later ennobled as Josef Roman Lorenz Ritter von Liburnau, was an Austrian naturalist. He is known for his studies in the fields of meteorology, phytogeography and agricultural sciences. He was the father of zoologist Ludwig Lorenz von Liburnau (1856–1943).
